No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The selected reconstructed sarsen-only introductory plan retains all thirty introduced regular outer upright footprints, all five inner pairs of trilithon supports in the northeast-opening horseshoe, and a separate explanatory two-post/one-lintel elevation. The elevation is moved below the plan, explicitly not a sixth trilithon. Outer footprints are enlarged to 9 by 9 mm square footprint glyphs in place of the original mildly rectangular introduced markers, paired inner supports to 9 by 10 mm, and pair separation independently widened. The original probable complete-circle reconstruction remains distinct from present ruins or the full phased monument. The outer plan radius is 70 mm and the inner horseshoe radius 40 mm; no stones or pairs are omitted.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The selected reconstructed sarsen-only introductory plan retains all thirty introduced regular outer upright footprints, all five inner pairs of trilithon supports in the northeast-opening horseshoe, and a separate explanatory two-post/one-lintel elevation. The elevation is moved below the plan, explicitly not a sixth trilithon. Outer footprints are enlarged to 9 by 9 mm square footprint glyphs in place of the original mildly rectangular introduced markers, paired inner supports to 9 by 10 mm, and pair separation independently widened. The original probable complete-circle reconstruction remains distinct from present ruins or the full phased monument. The outer plan radius is 70 mm and the inner horseshoe radius 40 mm; no stones or pairs are omitted. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
